source.synchronizationNote: Zen-Variables.zip (2026-09-28): Global Colors, Component Theme, Emphasis Level and Typography Configuration re-synced. Component Theme adds mode Neutral - S4 and Input/Border/Disabled; Emphasis Level adds mode Light; Typography Dashboard/Mobile values and four Light/*/11 greys changed. Text-style snapshots re-derived from the bound variables. Zen-Variables.zip (2026-09-29): Component Theme (export holds mode Neutral - S4 only) Chip-Secondary selected background, selected border and active border weight; Corner Radius Input/Small 12 / 12 / 8 / 2. Component Theme.json (2026-09-29, mode Neutral - S3 only) sets Chip-Secondary selected background to Neutral/Pale/Default; by the user's decision the repo keeps S3 at Active/Neutral/Subtle, and the live file was set to the same value (read 2026-09-29 02:55). Global Colors.json (2026-09-29, mode Zen): step 3 of every Light and Dark ramp and its Alpha twin re-synced (79 values; Light slightly darker, Dark slightly lighter); no names added, removed or renamed. Global Colors.json (2026-09-29, second export): Dark/Gray/9 #656565 → #929292 and Dark/Gray-Alpha/9 → #FFFFFF8B (the Zen Plugin Dark Neutral step 9). At the user's request the VT, Chat, Brand-Ananas and Neutral-Ananas ramps (Light/Dark and Alpha, 192 variables, no aliases or CSS consumers) were removed from the repo, so Global Colors has 960 variables and the repo 2,176. The Figma file and its exports still hold these ramps, so drop them again on the next sync or delete them in Figma. The hidden count assumes they were hidden. Global Colors.json (2026-09-29, third export): 69 Dark/*-Alpha values at steps 1–9 re-synced (step 3 only in Golden, Mint, Orange and Yellow). Most old ones were near-opaque dark colours (alpha F5 at steps 4–8), the new ones bright hues at low alpha, e.g. Dark/Teal-Alpha/5 #003F37F5 → #00FFDB2F. The 192 removed ramps in the export stay out. Global Colors.json (2026-09-29, fourth export): 264 Dark values re-synced, Light unchanged. Steps 1–8 of the Dark solid ramps move slightly (mostly lighter, e.g. Dark/Gray/1 #0F0F0F → #121212, Dark/Blue/1 #0C0F14 → #0F1217; Dark/Gray/2 #1B1B1B → #191919), plus Dark/Gray/11–12 and 110 small Dark Alpha adjustments. The 192 removed ramps stay out. Global Colors.json (2026-10-03, mode Zen): 258 values re-synced (109 solid, 149 Alpha); no names added, removed or renamed, and the 192 removed ramps stay out. Light: Gray/4–6 slightly darker (Gray/4 #EAEAEA → #E5E5E5, Gray/5 #E2E2E2 → #DEDEDE, Gray/6 #DBDBDB → #D7D7D7), Gray/10 #828282 → #838383, Gray/12 #111111 → #121212 and their Alpha twins, plus one-step rounding on Orange/8, Orange-Alpha/8 and Brown/7. Dark: step 2 of every ramp slightly lighter (Dark/Gray/2 #191919 → #1A1A1A), steps 4–7 of the hue ramps slightly darker (e.g. Dark/Blue/6 #003E80 → #003B7C), Dark/Gray/4–10 slightly lighter (Dark/Gray/4 #262626 → #2A2A2A), Dark/Teal/8, and the Alpha twins (mostly steps 2 and 4–7).
